content.text: If you're a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-every-detail-you-6|COREMERCH guide to digital]] creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan, you've likely faced the frustration of being locked out of platforms like Teachable and Stripe. Stripe operates in only 46 out of 195 countries, leaving millions of creators without access to basic payment processing. This isn't just an inconvenience—it's a structural barrier to earning from your digital courses. Sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-4|infrastructure]] offers a permanent alternative, built on tools you own and control. This comparison dissects the tradeoffs between relying on restricted platforms and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-deploying-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-complete-11|How to]] your own stack.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Teachable and Stripe bundle hosting, payment processing, and course delivery into a single platform. For creators in supported countries, this simplifies setup but introduces dependency. Sovereign stacks, like the Edge Commerce Stack, use GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. You own the infrastructure, and no platform can suspend your access. The tradeoff? You handle deployment, but gain full control over your commerce architecture.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Teachable and Stripe explicitly exclude creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan due to regulatory or risk assessments. Even PayPal, despite broader availability, can suspend accounts for up to 180 days with no appeal. Sovereign stacks bypass these restrictions entirely. By using open tools like Cloudflare and Supabase, you're not subject to any platform's geographic policies. Your store operates on infrastructure you control, not on permissions granted by a third party.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, but only if you're in one of their 46 countries. NOWPayments, integrated into sovereign stacks, charges a flat 0.5% fee for crypto payments and supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Transactions confirm on-chain within minutes, and buyers don't need accounts. The real cost difference? With Stripe, you're at the mercy of their fee structure. With NOWPayments, you choose the blockchain network (BSC, Solana, TRON) to minimize fees under $0.10 per transaction.
Stripe’s 46-country limit isn’t a technical barrier—it’s a business decision. Sovereign infrastructure removes this constraint permanently.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Teachable owns your course data and delivery process. If their platform goes down, your sales stop. Sovereign stacks store orders in Supabase and deliver files via Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Automation is handled by Cloudflare Workers, which trigger file delivery the moment payment confirms. After deployment, COREMERCH has no access to your stack—you own it entirely. This architecture ensures your store operates independently of any single platform's uptime or policies.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you're in a Stripe-supported country and prioritize convenience over control, Teachable might suffice. But for creators in restricted regions, sovereign infrastructure is the only structural solution. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys a complete commerce stack in 48 hours, configured with 5 products, SPF/DKIM/DMARC email security, and end-to-end testing. Choose this if you want to own your commerce infrastructure, not rent it from platforms that can exclude you at will.

If Stripe is unavailable in your country, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This architecture bypasses platform restrictions entirely. For a complete solution, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes deployment, product loading, and 30-day support. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
PayPal’s 180-day fund holds are a risk creators in restricted countries can’t afford. Crypto payments via NOWPayments bypass this entirely.

Creators searching for Stripe alternatives in Nigeria or Gumroad replacements in Pakistan often overlook the importance of owning their commerce infrastructure. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a complete, deployable solution that doesn't rely on any platform's geographic permissions. For a step-by-step guide to deploying your own stack, start with the checklist below.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.

PayPal is available in some restricted countries but can suspend accounts for up to 180 days with no appeal. For reliable payments, deploy a sovereign stack with NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges only a 0.5% fee.

NOWPayments recommends BSC, Solana, and TRON networks for transaction fees under $0.10. These networks provide fast confirmations and low costs, making them ideal for digital product sales.

Basic familiarity with web tools is helpful, but the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes full deployment, configuration, and 30-day support. You’ll own a fully functional store without needing to code from scratch.
